description: March 21 birthday meaning: Pisces or Aries cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, March 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Pisces or Aries. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: March 21 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Aries season opens a new astrological year, and by March 21 the Sun has usually reached the first degree of the cardinal fire sign. Some years and early hours still give a Pisces Sun, so the precise time counts. Twenty-one reduces to 3, adding sparkle and expressiveness to the Mars-ruled first decan.

On March 21 the Sun usually sits at about 0° Aries, in the first decan, where Mars rules the decan as well as the sign. A birthday around March 19 to March 21 sits on the cusp between Pisces and Aries, the seam where the zodiac ends and begins again. Strictly speaking nobody is half one sign: the Sun is in one or the other, and the exact moment it crosses into Aries shifts by a day or so depending on the year, the time of birth and the place. A full chart settles it. Many cuspers still relate to both, pairing Pisces' imagination and empathy with Aries' urge to act. The blend is often described as a dreamer who also starts things.

sections.heading: March 21 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one March 21 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on March 21: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 21 is the 80th day of the year (81st in a leap year). By April 20, 30 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on March 21 include Jair Bolsonaro (1955), Joseph Fourier (1768) and Ronaldinho (1980).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 21?
faq.answer: March 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Pisces or Aries on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Aries. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 21 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 21?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 21?
faq.answer: March 21 is also the birthday of Jair Bolsonaro (1955), Joseph Fourier (1768) and Ronaldinho (1980). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
